rendered_refs: derived from supported EDK2 releases plus available Radxa, CIX, and local source refs
tree/object pins are recorded in config/refs/rendered.json

cix_bundle_policy.policy: The bundle records original CIX provenance. Internally TF-A and OP-TEE remain separate components so each can later be carried forward against newer Arm upstream releases.
cix_bundle_policy.provenance: Specific CIX release refs, object IDs, vendor paths, and upstream refs are recorded in config/refs/cix.json.

companion_edk2_repo_policy.edk2_platforms_and_non_osi: These upstream repos do not publish matching edk2-stableYYYYMM tags. The deterministic mapping is the latest upstream master commit at or before the matching EDK2 stable tag committer timestamp.

delta_artefact_policy.format: A delta artefact branch contains README.md, metadata.json, and delta.patch.
delta_artefact_policy.reason: Patch artefacts encode additions, modifications, deletes, renames, binary files, and intentional absence relative to a base tree.
delta_artefact_policy.render_order: Render plans are synthesised from the selected source/release branch name and available source/base, source/component, and source/delta refs: component skeleton base, vendor delta artefacts, component replacements, then local delta artefacts.

op_tee_3.17.0_to_cix_1.2.assessment: Larger vendor delta but still recognisable as an Arm OP-TEE derived tree; keep component linkage.

tf-a_v2.7_to_cix_1.2.assessment: Moderate vendor delta; suitable for component layering and possible future Arm uplift.

local_roll_forward_policy.covered_edk2_releases: derived from source/base/edk2/edk2/edk2-stable* refs from 202208 onward plus source/unofficial/edk2-stable* refs
local_roll_forward_policy.generated_delta_refs: source/delta/local/<edk2-release> for the CIX/Radxa matrix, with a more specific suffix when the same EDK2 release has multiple local bases
local_roll_forward_policy.policy: Local changes are maintained as ordinary source branches and projected into per-EDK2-release delta artefacts. The current branch points at the latest local source; compatibility branches and tags preserve earlier EDK2 overlay points as full source checkpoints. If the same local source commit overlays multiple EDK2 releases cleanly, multiple compatibility tags may point to it. If a release requires maintenance, commit that maintenance at the first affected release and tag the resulting compatible commit. Generated source refs and delta artefacts must not depend on the branch names used during earlier migrations.

rendering_requirements: recursively materialise submodules at every depth
produce ordinary files rather than gitlinks
remove active root .gitmodules files from rendered branches
store original submodule metadata in reports/manifests
preserve upstream/vendor source linkage in manifests and commit trailers
normal git log <path> and git blame <path> must work from any directory inside the repo
